HISTORY 
 
GENERAL OBJECTIVES 
 
The aim of the Unified Tertiary Matriculation Examination (UTME) syllabus in History is to prepare 
the candidates for the Board’s examinations.  It is designed to test their achievement of the course 
objectives, which are to: 
1. 
Impart knowledge of Nigerian history from earliest times to the present; 
2. 
Identify the similarities and relationships among the peoples of Nigeria as they relate to the 
issues of national unity and integration; 
3. 
Appreciate Nigerian history as the basis to understand West African and African history; 
4. 
Apply history to understand Nigerian and Africa’s relationship with the wider world; 
 
5. 
analyse issues of modernization and development; 
6. 
Relate the past to the present and plan for the future.
